about_short_description.short_description: Extreme Networks provides wired and wireless networking solutions to enhance connectivity for businesses and organizations.

product.name: Extreme Platform ONE™
product.description: An integrated networking platform that combines AI, network management, security, and support workflows across wired, wireless, fabric, SD-WAN, and third-party infrastructure.

product.name: ExtremeCloud™ IQ
product.description: A cloud-based network management platform for monitoring, configuring, and analyzing wired and wireless infrastructure, with AI-assisted operations and centralized visibility.

product.name: Extreme Fabric
product.description: A network fabric solution that automates and secures connectivity across campus, data center, branch, and operational technology environments.

product.name: Wired Access
product.description: A portfolio of wired networking infrastructure spanning edge and core connectivity for enterprise, campus, branch, data center, and operational technology environments.

product.name: Wireless Access
product.description: A wireless networking portfolio that provides indoor and outdoor Wi-Fi connectivity, including high-performance 6 GHz and Wi-Fi 7 deployments.

product.name: Network Security
product.description: Integrated network security capabilities including zero-trust network access, network access control, secure fabric connectivity, and wireless intrusion prevention.
